 Observation, Poison Perception, Reading Tracks, Surveillance, Tracking This
 category includes those skills which involve the organized use of one’s
 ability to recognize and assimilate clues and information in the pursuit of
 some specific goal, in a structured fashion, as opposed to a spontaneous or
 unstructured application of such abilities (e.g., an attempt to orient
 oneself to a combat situation after taking a stunning blow would not be an
 application of an Awareness • Searching skill, but to trying to read the
 signs of a battle afterwards in order to perceive the course it had taken
 would be).

@@ Detect Traps
@stat: In
@description:
 Descriptions This skill provides a bonus for detecting inanimate traps
 ambushes. Note that this skill is not “automatic”; the individual must
 state that he is searching for signs of a trap or ambush skill to come into
 play.

@@ Observation
@stat: SD
@description:
 or This skill provides a bonus for noticing details about environment for
 assimilation and analysis. This is normally only for this usable in an
 active fashion, and requires concentration. Note this skill is different
 from Alertness, which represents a general and unconscious level of
 receptivity and awareness of events details within one's immediate
 environment. This skill reflects by an the active observation, noting and
 appraisal of such details. within example, if a character were about make
 camp in an unsafe location, the GM might make an Alertness static maneuver
 that character to determine whether or not he notices the danger. If the
 character indicated that he wished to examine the location for suitability,
 the character would instead make an Observation static maneuver.

@@ Poison Perception
@stat: Me
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for perceiving the presence poison in/on an
 item or object. Note that some poisons will simply or be undetectable
 (e.g., a colorless, tasteless, odorless powder dissolves completely in
 water will be very difficult if not imposto -70 sible to detect). to -70

@@ Reading Tracks
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for gleaning information from a set of tracks
 or spoor. Detailed information about the tracks can obtained, such as type
 of creatures, age tracks, weight of creature, speed creature moving at,
 back tracking, etc. This skill used for identifying the tracks and the
 skill Tracking (q.v.) is used for spotting and lowing the tracks.

@@ Surveillance
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for keeping watch over a person, place or
 object. Also includes the ability to determine the best approach and
 technique in solving a crime.

@@ Tracking
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for tracking maneuvers and following of a trail
 left someone or something such as foot prints, broken branches, crushed
 grass, hanging pieces of cloth, etc. The skill Reading Tracks gives the
 tracker the information about tracks.

-26 down | Spectacular Failure | -25% | 1.0u | -30 | You glean enormous amounts of information about your target…all of it wrong. A dangerous target will be perceived as safe, and vice versa. You utterly misrepresent what you perceive, and you are sure that you are correct.
-25 — 04 | Absolute Failure | 0% | 2.0u | -10 | There is a great future waiting for you as an art critic. You fail to notice even the most obvious information about your target.
05 — 75 | Failure | 0% | 1.0u | +0 | Attempting to emulate the perceptive abilities of an eggplant, you notice nothing useful.
UM 66 | Unusual Event | 100% | 3.0u | +10 | You gain full information about your target, but the event triggers a flashback to your past. The memory of some similar event, item, or person rushes back to you and consumes your attention for 3 rounds, during which time you relive the experience in a trance-like state. You act as if stunned (no parry) during this time, although you may make a -30 Awareness static maneuver (see Section 21.2) to emerge earlier. If you are struck or shaken, you will emerge from the trance automatically.
76 — 90 | Partial Success | 20% | 1.75u | +0 | Your interest is piqued, but you can glean minimal information. You may try again in 6 rounds, if appropriate.
UM 100 | Unusual Success | 130% | 0.5u | +30 | Shades of the Oracle! Your powerful perception pierces the veil of ignorance; you notice everything relevant about your target, and you may make a free (0% activity) static maneuver for the purposes of analysis or identification (e.g., a Science/Analytic static maneuver, a Lore static maneuver, etc.).
91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 1.0u | +10 | Following your instincts, you focus your attention. You gather some general information on your target, but not the specifics which you feel lie just beyond your grasp. If appropriate, roll again next round with a modification of +10 to pinpoint what has eluded you.
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +20 | Extraordinary! Your finely-tuned perception has revealed that which you sought.
176 up | Absolute Success | 120% | 1.0u | +30 | Elementary, my dear boy! You identify with casual ease the target and/or information you seek, along with contextual information not obvious to a lesser eye. Specific target for search: +10 to +50
